title: Workflows: Now enroll opportunities and tasks without a contact
text:
Opportunities and tasks can now enter workflows directly, even when they have no associated contact. Automate follow-up for a deal or an internal task without first creating or linking a contact.
What's changed?
Previously, an opportunity or task needed an associated contact before it could enter a workflow. That requirement has been removed. When an opportunity or task matches a workflow trigger, the record can enter and continue through the workflow on its own.
- Opportunities: Start a workflow when an opportunity is created, changes, moves stage, changes status, or becomes stale, including when it has no associated contact.
- Tasks: Use task triggers such as Task added, Task completed, and Task reminder for tasks without an associated contact.
- Opportunity date reminders: Use Custom date reminder with an Opportunity date field to start a workflow based on a date stored on an opportunity.
How to get started
- Go to Automations > Workflows and create or open a workflow.
- Add an opportunity or task trigger and configure any filters you need. For a date-based reminder, choose Custom date reminder and select an Opportunity date field.
- Add the actions for your process and save the workflow.
For example, an opportunity without a contact can enter a workflow when it is created, so your team can assign an owner and begin working the deal. An internal task without a contact can also enter a workflow when it is completed to begin the next step of a handoff.
Good to know
Review actions that depend on contact information or a contact recipient when building a workflow for records without a contact. Those details are unavailable when no contact is associated with the record.
